Curriculum & Playbooks

Architecture Playbooks & Learning Paths

Practical, opinionated engineering playbooks drawn from real-world enterprise delivery. No toy examples — each track focuses on the failure modes, governance boundaries, and design patterns needed to build and scale production platforms.

Track 01 / Production Playbook

Terraform for Enterprise Production

An authoritative curriculum on building and governing Terraform in enterprise AWS environments — covering modular architecture, remote state isolation, zero-downtime refactoring, secrets hygiene, and automated CI/CD guardrails.

Terraform 1.5+ · AWS · HCL · Checkov · TFLint · S3 & DynamoDB

6 Production modules
45 min total read
Intermediate to Advanced Explore curriculum →
Track 02 / Migration Playbook

Enterprise Cloud Migration: Assess, Mobilize & Modernize

An authoritative architectural and financial guide for enterprise cloud migrations — comparing rapid (4–6 wk) vs. deep (3–4 mo) assessments, 3-year TCO modeling (On-Demand, 1-Yr, 3-Yr RIs/Savings Plans, Microsoft licensing), target Landing Zone design, Mobilize wave planning, and in-flight modernization.

AWS MAP · AWS Transform · RVTools · TCO Modeling · Landing Zone · Amazon EKS

6 Delivery modules
50 min total read
Intermediate to Executive Explore curriculum →
Track 03 / Operations Playbook

Kubernetes Ingress & Operations on Amazon EKS

A hands-on operations playbook for running multi-environment Amazon EKS in production — dual ingress architecture and its real cost mechanics, IAM/RBAC across clusters, headless container delivery, and day-2 incident triage.

Amazon EKS · Kubernetes · AWS Load Balancer Controller · Nginx Ingress · AWS ECR

4 Operations modules
30 min total read
